meta.name: ulw-research
meta.description: Team-first maximum-saturation research orchestration for omo-senpi. Scopes solo, ALWAYS asks which final format to render (PDF+DOCX default), then stands up a max-size cooperating team (team_create): one member per axis plus skeptic/red-team members for ultradebate/hyperdebate cross-critique, explore/librarian lanes, live ulw-loop journaling, an EXPAND loop until leads run dry, claims proven by code or the claim-graph gate, and a cited synthesis with charts/Mermaid/assets behind visual-QA and `writing` proofread gates. ACTIVATES ONLY on an explicit user demand for research: the word 'ulw-research' ('/ulw-research', '$ulw-research'), any 'ulw' research wording, 'ultradebate' or 'hyperdebate' research requests, or an explicit request for research / deep research / an ultra-precise investigation, in any language. Never self-activates for ordinary questions, debugging, or implementation context-gathering. While active it overrides exploration-bounding defaults: exhaustive coverage is the goal.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 组建多智能体辩论团队，穷尽式深挖问题并产出带引用的综合报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果遇到难以定论的复杂课题时，希望自动启动一支多角色研究团队穷尽论证
copy.tagline_en: Orchestrate multi-agent deep research and deliver a cited synthesis.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a thorough, multi-angle investigation on a hard question without managing many sub-agents yourself.

howto.what: 激活后,Claude 会先问你要什么格式(默认 PDF+DOCX),然后组建最大规模研究团队:按方向分工、互相辩论质疑、追查所有线索,用代码验证争议说法,最后产出带引用的综合报告,并经过视觉和文字校对。
howto.when: 当你说出“ulw-research”等触发词,或明确要求深度研究、ultradebate/hyperdebate 式研究时触发。普通问答、调试不会自动激活。

say.text: 用 ulw-research 研究一下 RAG 的最新进展
say.note: Claude 会组建团队并开始饱和式研究。

say.text: 我需要一份深度研究报告:对比 PostgreSQL 和 SQLite
say.note: 它会先确认输出格式,再启动研究流程。

say.text: 启动 hyperdebate 研究:大型语言模型真的理解语言吗?
say.note: 会触发辩论式交叉质询,并产出带引用的结论。

howto.what_en: Once activated, Claude asks for the final format (PDF+DOCX by default), then stands up a max-size research team: one member per axis, debate-based cross-critique, exhaustive lead-chasing, code-verified contested claims, and a cited synthesis that passes visual QA and writing proofread.
howto.when_en: Triggers only when you explicitly request research: saying 'ulw-research', asking for deep research, or an ultradebate/hyperdebate research request. Ordinary questions and debugging never auto-activate it.

say_en.text: Use ulw-research to investigate the latest advances in RAG.
say_en.note: Claude will assemble a team and start saturation research.

say_en.text: I need a deep-research report comparing PostgreSQL and SQLite.
say_en.note: It will confirm the output format first, then start the research.

say_en.text: Launch a hyperdebate research: do LLMs really understand language?
say_en.note: Triggers debate-style cross-critique and a cited conclusion.
